report_md:
## Vacancy assessment

**Verdict:** likely_vacant (0.87 confidence).

The strongest evidence is parcel-specific: Oakland's FY 2025-26 final assessment roll and FY 2026-27 preliminary roll both list APN 003-0021-008-00 under use code 1000. Alameda County defines code 1000 as vacant residential land zoned for four or fewer units. The two city rolls are dated about 11.5 months apart, which supports a recurring vacant-land classification. It does not prove that no one occupied the site throughout that interval or that it remains physically vacant today.

Redfin reports a fire-damage demolition permit marked final on 2025-05-27, but this is secondary reporting and its permit history may be incomplete or inaccurate. Its page retains older building facts. A LoopNet listing calls the broader 2321-2323 assemblage 100% leased, but describes a 5,489 sq ft site versus 3,000 sq ft for this APN, so it is not clear evidence of occupancy at this parcel. No direct current site observation, utility record, or parcel-specific city permit/code-enforcement result was confirmed.

**Start/duration:** The first official vacancy-related signal found is the FY 2025-26 roll prepared 2025-04-09; the next FY 2026-27 preliminary roll dated 2026-03-23 repeats the code 1000 classification. These records are nearly 12 months apart. Actual move-out date and continuous physical vacancy duration remain unknown.

**Sources:** [Oakland FY 2026-27 preliminary roll](https://oakland.legistar.com/View.ashx?GUID=98960195-0F2B-4DB3-8895-AF61933F57B1&ID=15426144&M=F); [Oakland FY 2025-26 final roll](https://oakland.legistar.com/View.ashx?G=undefined&GUID=83E8A6A8-2D60-4CBC-8F51-327CBC7B8C09&ID=14230005&M=F); [Alameda County use-code list](https://propinfo.acgov.org/UseCodeList/); [Redfin exact-parcel record](https://www.redfin.com/CA/Oakland/2321-San-Pablo-Ave-94612/home/49876921); [LoopNet combined-parcel listing](https://www.loopnet.com/Listing/2321-2323-San-Pablo-Ave-Oakland-CA/38424343/).
